risk_note: RV2 (risk + entry.ts). R-04 option A (owner 2026-10-23) / orchestrator 13:31 ②: Redis generation detection. Signed requests run one atomic Lua script after the HMAC check: read or create risk:generation (value = creation time from the injected Clock), refuse with 50001 within NONCE_TTL_SECONDS (BR-ID-09) of the shared creation time without reserving the nonce, otherwise SET NX the nonce. Verifiers built without an explicit gate (recordConsent clipboard signature) use the process-level gate. The worker renews the key every 60 seconds (TTL 1800 s; recreates it when missing). Armed only for APP_ENV staging / prod by entry.ts; local / test unchanged. Redis unavailable stays fail-closed (50001). Fast and full verification passed on the AWS test machine (rule tests 14/14); required CI checks run on the PR head. Runbook (delete the key before reopening after a restore) is ops' part.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S1 recordConsent clipboard signature not gated; S2 gate and nonce reservation not atomic), both fixed in round 2; round 2 pass (couli-runs/B1-02zi/review-money-r1.json, review-money-r2.json); Codex unavailable until 10-30 (approvals #36)
